stem: Ira has a paper cut-out of a capital letter $H$. She wants to decide whether it has line symmetry and whether it has rotational symmetry.

options.text: Answer rotational symmetry alone, naming that label instead of running both tests.
Apply the fold test for line symmetry and the turn test for rotational symmetry as separate checks.
Decide from a single glance that whatever is true of one kind of symmetry is automatically true of the other.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Line symmetry and rotational symmetry are decided by different tests, so each must be checked on its own for the letter $H$.

teacher.key_rationale: Fold and turn tests settle the two kinds independently. Naming one label alone substitutes a term. Treating one glance as both omits the separate-test condition.
